description: Query the EPCIS 2.0 repository as the signed-in user, who sees exactly what their account may read. Filters are EPCIS Query Language parameters; every one is optional and they are AND-ed, several values of one comma-separated are OR-ed. Identifiers are GS1 Digital Links (https://id.gs1.org/01/<gtin>/21/<serial>, /10/<lot>, /00/<sscc>, /414/<gln>/254/<ext>) or EPC URNs. Answers one page, newest first, each event compact with its eventID; pass nextPage back for more.

bizLocation.description: Business Location, an SGLN Digital Link (EQ_bizLocation)

bizStep.description: CBV bizStep, bare (shipping) or as URI

disposition.description: CBV disposition, bare (in_transit) or as URI

epc.description: an instance or class identifier anywhere in the event (MATCH_anyEPC / MATCH_anyEPCClass)

eventType.description: ObjectEvent, AggregationEvent, TransformationEvent, AssociationEvent or TransactionEvent

from.description: events at or after this time, ISO 8601 (GE_eventTime)

limit.description: events on this page, 1 to the server's page size

more.description: further EPCIS query parameters as a query string, e.g. EQ_bizTransaction_po=urn:...&EXISTS_mc:orderLines=true

nextPage.description: the nextPage of a previous answer; the other filters are then ignored

readPoint.description: Read Point, an SGLN Digital Link (EQ_readPoint)

name: query_events
title: Query EPCIS events
